description: The robot vacuum is unable to move because it is trapped or blocked.
recommended_fixes: Remove any obstacles around the robot vacuum.
Place the robot on a clear, level surface.
Restart the cleaning cycle after the obstruction is removed.

description: The battery charge is too low for the robot vacuum to continue operating.
automatic_fix: Send robot vacuum back to its charging dock.
recommended_fixes: Return the robot vacuum to its charging dock.
Allow the battery to recharge before resuming cleaning.
Check that the charging dock has power if charging does not begin.

description: The water tank is empty and the robot vacuum cannot continue mopping.
recommended_fixes: Refill the water tank.
Ensure the tank is properly installed.
Resume the mopping cycle once the tank has been refilled.

description: The robot vacuum cannot start or continue its current cleaning task.
recommended_fixes: Check that the robot vacuum is ready to operate.
Check for any active errors preventing the cleaning task.
Restart the cleaning task after resolving the issue.

description: The robot vacuum started an operation but could not finish it successfully.
recommended_fixes: Check the robot vacuum for any active problems.
Resolve any obstruction or condition preventing the operation.
Restart the operation after resolving the issue.

description:
The requested command cannot be performed because the robot vacuum 
is currently in an incompatible state.
recommended_fixes: Wait for the current robot operation to finish.
Check the current state of the robot vacuum.
Try the command again when the robot is ready.

description: The robot vacuum cannot locate its charging dock to recharge.
recommended_fixes: Make sure the charging dock is accessible.
Check that the charging dock has power.
Place the robot vacuum near the charging dock and try again.

description: The dust bin has been removed or is not properly installed.
recommended_fixes: Install the dust bin.
Make sure the dust bin is properly seated.
Restart the cleaning operation.

description: The dust bin has reached its maximum capacity.
recommended_fixes: Empty the dust bin.
Reinstall the dust bin properly.
Resume cleaning after the dust bin has been emptied.

description: The water tank is not installed.
recommended_fixes: Install the water tank.
Make sure the tank is properly seated.
Resume mopping after installing the tank.

description: The water tank lid has not been closed properly.
recommended_fixes: Close the water tank lid properly.
Make sure the lid is securely latched.
Resume mopping after closing the lid.

description: The mop cleaning pad is missing or not attached correctly.
recommended_fixes: Attach the mop cleaning pad.
Make sure the pad is installed correctly.
Resume mopping after installing the pad.

description: The robot vacuum cannot access the area it was instructed to clean.
recommended_fixes: Check for obstacles blocking the robot's path.
Make sure the target area is accessible.
Clear the path and try the cleaning task again.

description: The dirty-water tank has reached capacity.
recommended_fixes: Empty the dirty-water tank.
Reinstall the tank properly.
Resume mopping after emptying the tank.

description: The dirty-water tank is missing or not installed.
recommended_fixes: Install the dirty-water tank.
Make sure the tank is properly seated.
Resume mopping after installing the tank.

description: One or more wheels cannot rotate normally because they are blocked.
recommended_fixes: Check the wheels for debris or obstructions.
Remove anything preventing the wheels from rotating.
Try the cleaning operation again after clearing the wheels.

description: The main cleaning brush cannot rotate because it is obstructed.
recommended_fixes: Check the main brush for hair, debris, or other obstructions.
Remove anything preventing the brush from rotating.
Resume cleaning after clearing the brush.

description: A navigation sensor is blocked or covered, preventing accurate navigation.
recommended_fixes: Check the navigation sensors for dirt or obstructions.
Clean the affected sensor.
Resume the cleaning operation after clearing the sensor.

description: The indoor room temperature sensor is failing and cannot accurately measure the room temperature.
recommended_fixes: Inspect the thermostat for visible damage.
Check that the sensor is properly connected.
Replace or service the thermostat if the issue persists.

description: The HVAC fan is failing or not operating correctly, affecting airflow.
recommended_fixes: Verify that the HVAC system has power.
Inspect the fan for visible obstructions.
Contact an HVAC technician if the fan does not operate.

description: The HVAC compressor is failing or not operating correctly, preventing normal heating or cooling.
recommended_fixes: Turn off the HVAC system to prevent further damage.
Check the system for error indicators.
Contact a qualified HVAC technician for repair.

description: The outdoor temperature sensor is failing and cannot provide reliable external temperature data.
recommended_fixes: Inspect the outdoor temperature sensor for visible damage.
Check that the sensor is properly connected.
Replace or service the sensor if the issue persists.

description: The coil temperature sensor is failing and cannot provide reliable temperature data.
recommended_fixes: Inspect the coil temperature sensor for visible damage.
Check that the sensor is properly connected.
Replace or service the sensor if the issue persists.
